notes.title: Boss Course Revision Guideline Changes
notes.notes:
Hello, This is EZ2ON Team.

As a result of reviewing many players' play records and feedback while operating the course mode, we previously announced changes related to the difficulty settings of the 'boss' category in the course mode revision plan during the official broadcast .

We intended to reflect this content from the LEVEL : ALPHA course, but after the update, based on the production team's review and reflecting the requests of players who wanted a more intuitive revision plan, we have adjusted the revision guidelines as follows to allow players to infer the nature of the course through the boss course difficulty.

※ Balance: This refers to detailed judgment settings and gauge increase/decrease amounts.
This is adjusted considering each course's concept, gimmicks, BPM-based beat intervals, etc., and is applied to all boss-level courses in EZ2ON.

Characteristics by Difficulty

HD: This is the baseline difficulty for boss planning. The KOOL judgment criteria are the same as in STANDARD mode, but balance adjustments make the play feel stricter than STANDARD.
NM: This is a difficulty where boss gimmicks are adjusted to be easier to play compared to HD. While balance settings are in place, it's a course that can generally be challenged with STANDARD mode playing sensibilities.
EX: While patterns are the same as HD or only some gimmicks become more difficult, the KOOL judgment criteria and balance settings become significantly more difficult compared to HD. (However, bosses with complicated patterns that fall into the challenge realm are set as CHALLENGE difficulty.)
EZ: This is a difficulty where patterns are the same as NM or only some gimmicks are different, and the KOOL judgment criteria are easier than STANDARD.

The revision plan was prepared to redefine higher-difficulty bosses, and THE 7 course follows these revision guidelines.

Hello fellow players, This is EZ2ON Team.

● What's New

EZ2ON REBOOT: R 2.0 Update Plan Begins
The plan for EZ2ON REBOOT: R 2.0 update has started, with changes in the standard theme and common UI & UX leading to various improvements.

The update will be carried out sequentially, and in this update, the 'Mode Select Screen' of the basic theme has been improved.

Additionally, there will be various other improvements made as part of this update.

Introducing 8K BASIC
Initially, we designed STANDARD and BASIC modes to cater to different player preferences:
STANDARD offered stricter timing, while BASIC provided a more relaxed experience.
STANDARD mode included four key modes (4 keys, 5 keys, 6 keys, and 8 keys), but BASIC originally featured only 4, 5, and 6 key modes.

Our original intention was for 8K to be the ultimate endgame, exclusive to the most skillful players.
However, after years of live service and feedback, we realized that restricting content based on skill level wasn't the best approach.
We put a lot of effort into designing 8K patterns, but if players were hesitant to try them, our hard work would go unappreciated.

With this update, we're excited to introduce 8K BASIC mode, making our unique gameplay experience accessible to a wider audience.
We hope this change encourages more players to challenge themselves and enjoy everything our game has to offer.



「A Site De La Rue」 Hands-on preview
The work-in-progress version of 「A Site De La Rue」, the part of the ENDLESS CIRCULATION DLC,
will be showcased as a time-limited preview. Players will have a chance to experience the new content and offer feedback before its official release.

It's important to note that personal records and leaderboards will be wiped after the preview event,
and the scores obtained during the preview event will not count toward your official rating.



Added cooldown timer to COURSE
To improve your experience in COURSE mode, we have introduced a 30-second cooldown timer between songs.
This addition allows for brief breaks during the continuous four-song gameplay, providing a chance to catch your breath and refocus.

With the new change, you will have an optional 30-second break time after each song,
which can be skipped by pressing 'Enter'. This helps maintain a balance in COURSE mode,
offering a moment to recover or adjust your setup before diving back into the rhythm.



Enhanced input customization
We've implemented an update to provide you with greater control over your keyboard settings in the game.

This addition primarily focuses on the followings : 
- Direct processing of keyboard inputs, bypassing default OS key bindings
- Ability to use keys like "Shift" without input issues or OS-level shortcut interference
- Option to disable the Windows key, preventing accidental exits to the desktop

If you want to try out the new feature, head to OPTIONS > KEY INPUT METHOD and select "STANDARD".
OPTIONS > IGNORE WINDOWS KEY is also available for those who use "STANDARD" as an active input method.



Added "KEY SOUND ASSISTANT" option.
When enabled, all key sounds will be played during gameplay regardless of input.
However, it's important to note that the KEY SOUND ASSISTANT feature does not work in SUPER HARD difficulty or COURSE mode.



Added new courses
In this update, we have added the following courses :
'Hard Beat Underground' 4K, 8K
'Hard Beat Stage' 5K, 6K
'PP Maglev Central Line' 4K, 5K, 6K, 8K



Revised rating system
We have fine-tuned the rating calculation in our rhythm game.
The rating system will persist until ENDLESS CIRCULATION DLC release. Also, the DLC release bring a significant formula change. Stay tuned for further details.

Hello! This is FOX-B, the Producer of EZ2ON REBOOT : R.

We've decided to delay the release of 「PRESTIGE PASS」 DLC - CHAPTER II Update 2. 


 Initial Release Date: November 30th
 Changed Release Date: December 16th

First and foremost, we are truly sorry for the delay. It was a very, very tough decision to make.
Because obviously, you can't just delay the update a week before its release.
That's a huge letdown as a player. But during the content reviewing process, 
we thought those didn't quite meet our quality expectations. 

As compensation for the delay, we brought a small gift.


 2 「PRESTIGE PASS」 DLC exclusive licensed songs

Our team has always valued the quality of the content.
We want you, the players, to really get into the experience that 「PRESTIGE PASS」 can offer.
We aim to deliver something more than just gameplay. 

As always, thanks for bearing with us. And thank you for your support and appreciation. 



Expectations towards the game got bigger since the initial launch of the 「PRESTIGE PASS」. 
As expectations grew, we didn't want to disappoint the player base in terms of quality and quantity. 

Frankly, our initial plan for 2022 was a lot more, small, I would say. 
But the DLC launch changed everything.
Since that day, I just knew we gotta push ourselves to the limit and deliver the best we could give.
That's why it got "bigger" in terms of volume. 

The main reason behind the delay is the sudden spike in the development cost.
To counteract this, we are continuously tweaking and improving our workflow to be more efficient.
On top of that, we are constantly bringing in more workforce to our team. 



I think getting support from someone is a kind of double-edged sword.
It really drives you to achieve something cool. But sometimes, it puts you under pressure you made. 

Everyone in the development process feels it. 「PRESTIGE PASS」 has to be good.
There's no excuse for publishing content that lacks quality. 

With several extra weeks,
our team will be able to polish things up for the grand finale of 「PRESTIGE PASS」. Once again, we are very sorry for the delay.

notes.title: # Patch Note - Mar. 29
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players. This is EZ2ON TEAM.

● What's New 

- Windows 7 is now officially supported (Beta) — Quite unstable at the moment and will be improved. Since the package got changed completely, Steam will re-download the entire game.
- Increased the maximum note speed to 13 — Added a few more steps for the players who want to go further. 
- The "Fullscreen" option now offers a real fullscreen experience — instead of borderless windowed. 
- The client now mutes audio while in background. 
- Added a new note effector : "Mirror (Beta)"

● Bug Fixes and Improvements 

- Fixed video playback error and infinite load screen
- Optimized the audio engine
- Minor UX improvements

Thanks.

notes.title: # Patch Note - March 19
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players. This is NEONOVICE.
The maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience. 

▶ What's New
Adjusted parameters related to HP gauge — The goal here is to make the gameplay a bit more difficult.
It should feel more tougher to recover the HP loss. 

▶ Bug Fixes and Improvements
- Fixed infinite load screen
- Fixed some out-of-sync video playback
- Fixed miscellaneous UI glitches
- Fixed an issue where the judgement window fluctuates throughout the gameplay
- Improved overall load time 
- Temporary function added: Clicking ESC will cause the game to be over immediately.

We're rolling out a client patch so make sure to download it. 

Thanks.

notes.title: Announcement: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players. This is NEONOVICE.

We just deployed server-side hotfix addressing the following issues.
- Freeze upon selecting "Frantic"
- Freeze upon selecting "Showdown"
- Freeze upon selecting "ZtarwarZ"

We're currently investigating the issue that making the client freezes on load screen.
Also, there was a feedback that judgement timing is actually fluctuating during the gameplay. 
This needs further investigation and our dev team is trying to reproduce the issue. 
We will work on the other known issues as well so stay tuned. 

We sincerely apologize for the bad player experience.

Thanks.
